system.description: You can discover the "location" of anyone you know, wherever the target may be. This power requires the assistance of a Narrator. You must win a Static Mental Challenge against the target's Mental Traits. The Narrator notes the time of the Soul Scan and later informs you where the target was at that time. This power locates the mind of the individual sought; if the target is using powers such as Psychic Projection or Possession, Soul Scan finds where her conscious mind currently is.
